about: [C13 critic] VII picked cold from CHAPTERS on a fresh save, as the user would: what comes up under and after the chapter card, what the empty gun says in the dark (LMB, R), and the HUD. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/critic/c13/vii_cold.json
